title: Rush Hour
summary: Sliding-block puzzle with 180 verified 6x6 levels and BFS hints
description: Classic Rush Hour sliding-block puzzle built natively for CardputerZero (320x170) with automatic HDMI External Monitor Desktop Mode. Includes 180 unique, mathematically verified 6x6 levels across Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert tiers, a real-time optimal BFS hint solver, undo stack, star ratings, mouse drag support in Desktop Mode, primary F/Z/X/C movement + 4-8 soft-key controls, and a 3-second hold-ESC exit countdown.
